integrations.label: Claude Desktop/Web
integrations.hint: In Claude, go to Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector and paste this URL. Click Connect and approve — no token needed.
integrations.bearerHint: Paste into MCP settings and restart your client.

integrations.label: Claude Code
integrations.command: claude mcp add --transport http hypertask-mcp https://mcp.hypertask.ai/mcp
integrations.hint: Run this command in your terminal, then use /mcp in Claude Code to authenticate.
integrations.bearerHint: Paste into MCP settings and restart your client.

integrations.label: Codex
integrations.hint: Run this in your terminal, then run codex mcp login hypertask to authenticate.
integrations.bearerHint: Export your token as an env var, then register the server against it.

integrations.label: Cursor
integrations.hint: Add to Cursor MCP settings. Then run /mcp in Cursor to authenticate.
integrations.bearerHint: Paste into MCP settings and restart your client.

integrations.label: VS Code
integrations.hint: Run MCP: Open User Configuration (Ctrl+Shift+P) or add to .vscode/mcp.json. Paste the config, then restart VS Code. Requires VS Code 1.99+.
integrations.bearerHint: Use the bearer token config below. VS Code will prompt for the token on first connect.

integrations.label: ChatGPT
integrations.hint: Workspace admins: Settings → Apps & Connectors → Create. Add this MCP server URL. Requires ChatGPT Business, Enterprise, or Edu plan. Enable Developer mode in Permissions first.
integrations.bearerHint: When creating the app, choose Bearer token auth and paste your token.

integrations.label: Lovable
integrations.hint: Go to Settings → Connectors → Personal connectors → New MCP server. Enter the URL above. Choose Bearer token auth and paste your token. Requires a paid Lovable plan.
integrations.bearerHint: Paste your token when adding the server. Lovable will store it securely.
